verdict.rationale: Conductor documents cloud sandboxes where agents keep working after you close your laptop. Agents there can test repositories and run builds without per-step confirmation, and the work ends in a diff and pull-request review path. However, the build and test evidence is framed around configuring the environment, and nothing documents the agent producing a demo of the feature. missing for 10: agent-produced demo artifact (preview, recording, or screenshots of the working feature), explicit end-to-end feature build-and-test workflow docs, independent hands-on corroboration of cloud agents.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
When the work is ready, Conductor helps you review the diff, open a pull request, merge, and archive the workspace.
